answer: Give every identity one black onyx beacon slot per epoch: a short, randomly-assigned time window in which it must broadcast a fresh liveness signal — a signature over the epoch's random seed plus a hash of the last hour's ledger head. An attacker running N clones must keep N machines online and signing on schedule; any missed slot marks the identity dormant and slashes a small deposit. The willow of an honest participant bends cheaply — one signature costs nothing — but the sybil farmer pays the full operating cost and bond risk of every clone, every epoch.
